answer_1.quote: We consider several text generation tasks, including text summarization (TS), question-answering (QA) with long free-form answers, QA based on reading comprehension, QA with short free-form answers, and multiple-choice QA.
answer_1.outputs: Summaries, answers, claims, and uncertainty scores

answer_2.quote: To evaluate the quality of UQ methods on the selective generation task, we use the standard Prediction Rejection Ratio (PPR) metric... we use ROUGE-L, Accuracy, and AlignScore as text generation quality metrics. For claim-level fact-checking... we utilize the ROC-AUC and PR-AUC metrics.
